policy: Privacy review for residential aerial imagery

items.requirement: Document the lawful basis for processing aerial imagery of residential property.
Crop residential imagery to the insured property footprint before model inference.
Blur faces, vehicles and private gardens in exported evidence where not required for the claim.
Set a retention clock per event; delete raw imagery after the claim decision plus the legal minimum.
Role-based access: analyst, reviewer, auditor, customer. No shared accounts.
Sign a data-processing agreement and list every subprocessor, including the NPU vendor.
Offer on-site or private-cloud inference; no outbound network after imagery delivery.
Customer-facing notice explains AI assistance and the human decision.
No automated decision about people or property; an analyst signs every assessment.
Breach playbook with 72-hour notification and an audit-trail export.

note: This is an engineering checklist, not legal advice. Legal review is a pilot gate.
